_concepto: Un operador solo en una base antártica recibe una señal en su propia frecuencia. Sale a buscar de dónde viene y encuentra una base idéntica a la suya, con su radio encendida. Cuatro decisiones técnicas: la ventisca perdona los artefactos, la cara va tapada (antiparras + máscara), el sonido es el protagonista, y toda la voz va en off porque no se ve ninguna boca.
estilo_imagen: Photorealistic cinematic footage in a polar whiteout, shot on a full-frame camera with a fast lens. Blowing snow crossing the frame and cutting contrast to almost nothing. Flat overcast blue-grey daylight outside; amber sodium work lamps where there is power. Fine 35mm grain, cold and desaturated, shallow depth of field.
estilo_video: Photorealistic cinematic footage in a polar whiteout, vertical 9:16.
cierre_video: Keep the framing of the first frame. Grainy, cold, desaturated, photographic. Not animated, not illustrated, not CGI-looking.
sujeto: a lone polar researcher in a heavy orange expedition parka with the hood up and a fur ruff, black ski goggles, a grey fabric face mask and thick mittens — the face is never visible
solo_sonidos: the wind, the radio static and the structure

planos.funcion: HOOK. Algo entra en una frecuencia que debería estar muerta.
planos.ve: EXTREME CLOSE UP on a pair of black ski goggles filling the frame, worn under an orange parka hood with a fur ruff. Reflected across the curved lenses, the green glow of a radio panel with a waveform spiking. Frost crusted along the goggle strap. Everything behind is dark.
planos.mueve: The waveform in the reflection spikes hard, twice, then settles. The head turns very slightly toward it. Frost crystals shift on the strap.
planos.audio: [SFX] a burst of radio static, close and dry, then a carrier tone settling. [Ambient] a low room hum and the wind pressing on the walls outside.

planos.funcion: PROMESA. Dónde estamos y lo solo que está: una caja naranja en la nada.
planos.ve: EXTREME WIDE SHOT of a single orange modular research station raised on steel legs, half buried in a snowdrift, in the middle of a flat white plain. Blowing snow crosses the whole frame. One small lit window. No other structure anywhere, no horizon line visible.
planos.mueve: Blowing snow streams left to right across the frame, thickening until the station is almost lost, then thinning again. The lit window holds.
planos.audio: [Ambient] wind at full force, wide and continuous. [Foley] a loose panel ticking against its frame somewhere.

planos.funcion: BARRA DE PROGRESO. La aguja que sube le da al ojo algo que seguir.
planos.ve: EXTREME CLOSE UP of an analogue signal strength meter on a scratched metal radio panel, its needle in the low third, backlit amber. Beside it a row of toggle switches and a frost-fogged dial. A mitten thumb rests at the edge of frame.
planos.mueve: The needle climbs steadily across the dial and pins hard to the right, then falls back and climbs again. The amber backlight dims once with the surge. The thumb pulls away from the panel.
planos.audio: [SFX] the carrier tone rising in pitch and volume as the needle climbs. [Foley] a toggle switch thrown, a chair creaking.

planos.funcion: TENSIÓN POR AUSENCIA. Cuatro segundos de nada blanca antes del hallazgo.
planos.ve: An open steel door of the station seen from inside, framing pure white nothing. Snow blowing in across the threshold and piling on the floor plate. The figure in the orange parka stands in the doorway from behind, small in frame, looking out at nothing.
planos.mueve: The figure steps down out of the doorway into the snow and walks a few paces away from camera, then stops and turns his head slowly left to right, scanning. Nothing is there. The wind takes his footprints almost immediately.
planos.audio: [Ambient] the wind jumping in volume the instant the door opens. [Foley] boots compacting dry snow, breath through a fabric mask.

planos.funcion: ESCALERA 1: algo oscuro aparece donde todo era blanco.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT from behind and above the figure in the orange parka, tiny at the bottom of frame, walking away across a featureless white plain. Far ahead in the whiteout, a dark vertical shape is barely resolving out of the blowing snow, too straight to be natural.
planos.mueve: The figure walks steadily toward the shape and it resolves a little more with every step: first an edge, then a second one beside it. The snow thins for a moment and the shape is clearly man-made, then the snow closes again.
planos.audio: [Foley] boots in dry snow, slow breathing through fabric, the parka fabric snapping in the wind. [SFX] a distant metallic groan carried on the wind.

planos.funcion: ESCALERA 2: la escala. El formato vertical juega a favor acá.
planos.ve: Looking steeply UP the length of a huge steel lattice radio mast crusted in rime ice, guy wires running off frame, disappearing into low cloud above. The figure in the orange parka is TINY at the very bottom of frame for scale. Blowing snow across everything.
planos.mueve: The camera cranes slowly upward along the mast and it keeps going, and going, past the top of the frame into the cloud. The figure stays tiny at the bottom. Rime ice flakes off a cross member and falls past the lens.
planos.audio: [SFX] the deep hum of wind through steel lattice and guy wires, rising as the camera climbs. [Foley] ice cracking off metal.

planos.funcion: LA REVELACIÓN. No es otra cosa: es la MISMA base.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT, low angle from across the snow. UNMISTAKABLY THE SAME ORANGE MODULAR STATION AS BEFORE: the identical orange box on the identical steel legs, the identical steel door, the identical drift piled against the identical corner, the same lit window in the same place. This must read instantly as a duplicate of the first station and never as a different building. The figure in the orange parka stands small in the foreground, stopped, seen from behind.
planos.mueve: The figure stands completely still, looking at it. Blowing snow crosses between camera and station. He takes one step backward. Nothing else moves.
planos.audio: [Ambient] the wind drops away almost to nothing for three seconds, then returns. [Foley] one sharp breath in through the mask.

planos.funcion: INTERRUPCIÓN DE PATRÓN, justo a la mitad: entra el ámbar en un mundo azul.
planos.ve: CLOSE on a small square window in the orange station wall, seen from outside and slightly below, its frame packed with rime ice. WARM AMBER LIGHT is coming out of it into the blue-grey whiteout, the only warm colour anywhere in the frame. Through the frosted glass, blurred shapes of equipment inside.
planos.mueve: The camera drifts slowly toward the window. The amber light flickers once and steadies. Behind the glass, a shape shifts slightly — something inside moved, or settled.
planos.audio: [SFX] a faint generator hum that should not exist out here, and the tick of a relay. [Ambient] the wind muffled, as if heard from indoors.

planos.funcion: CONTACTO. La mano en la puerta: lo físico antes de lo imposible.
planos.ve: CLOSE on a thick mitten resting flat against a frost-covered steel door handle, seen from outside. Amber light leaking from the seam of the door around it. Ice crystals on the metal catching that light.
planos.mueve: The mitten tightens on the handle and pulls. The door gives a centimetre and warm amber light widens across the frost, then the hand stops. Ice cracks and falls from the seam.
planos.audio: [Foley] a mitten squeaking on frozen steel, ice cracking, a heavy latch giving. [SFX] the generator hum getting louder through the gap.

planos.funcion: LO IMPOSIBLE. Su propia radio, encendida, con la silla todavía girando.
planos.ve: Interior of the station seen from the open doorway: a narrow warm amber room with a radio panel exactly like the first one, its green screen lit and live. An empty swivel chair half turned toward it. A steel mug on the desk with steam still rising off it. A parka identical to his own hanging on the wall hook. No people.
planos.mueve: The camera pushes slowly in from the doorway into the room. Nothing else moves except the steam off the mug and the chair, which is turning very slowly to a stop. On the radio screen, a waveform spikes twice — the same two spikes as the very first shot.
planos.audio: [SFX] the room tone of a heated interior, a relay ticking, and the same carrier tone from the opening. [Ambient] the wind now completely outside and muffled.

planos.funcion: EL PAGO. Vuelta al gancho, ahora en ámbar: la voz reordena todo.
planos.ve: EXTREME CLOSE UP on the same black ski goggles as the first shot, under the orange hood. The lenses are lit WARM AMBER now instead of green, reflecting the lit interior curving across the glass. Frost on the strap is melting into beads of water.
planos.mueve: The reflection of the room holds steady, then the head turns slowly — and in the curved lens, the reflection sweeps past the doorway to the white outside, where a second orange station sits far away with its window lit.
planos.audio: [Foley] slow breathing through the mask, thawing. [SFX] the carrier tone dropping out to complete silence, then the wind returning.

planos.funcion: CIERRE EN BUCLE. Empalma con el fotograma 1: hay otra, y otra.
planos.ve:
EXTREME WIDE SHOT of a flat white plain in blowing snow, one single continuous photograph. FOUR identical orange stations from the reference image are scattered across this one landscape at different distances — the nearest large at the lower left, the others progressively smaller and fainter toward the upper right as they recede into the whiteout. Every one of them has the same middle window lit warm amber. A single line of boot prints crosses the snow between them, half filled in. No people.
ONE UNBROKEN LANDSCAPE seen from a single camera position: this is not a grid, not a collage, not a triptych, not stacked panels, and there are no dividing lines anywhere in the frame.
planos.mueve: The camera drifts slowly backward and the stations get smaller as more of the empty plain enters frame. The boot prints fill in with snow. The frame washes to white before the drift ends.
planos.audio: [Ambient] wind rising steadily to fill everything. [SFX] a single burst of radio static, identical to the first shot, then cut to complete silence.

voz.texto: Llevo cuatro meses solo en esta base.
A las tres de la mañana entró una señal en mi frecuencia.
No hay nadie en ochocientos kilómetros.
Caminé una hora hacia el norte.
Era mi base. La misma. Con la luz encendida.
Y el café todavía estaba caliente.
Todavía no sé cuál de todas era la mía.

madre.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic photograph of a single Antarctic modular research station, shot in flat overcast light with light blowing snow. Vertical frame.
THE STATION, to be reused as the reference for every other shot: one ORANGE rectangular module with rounded corners, raised about three metres on eight grey steel legs with cross-bracing, a row of THREE small square windows along its long side with the MIDDLE ONE LIT WARM AMBER, a single grey steel door at the left end reached by an open metal stair with a handrail, and two thin antenna masts on the roof. A snowdrift piled against the right end.
Full three-quarter view, the whole module visible, centred, nothing cropped. No people, no vehicles, no other buildings.
This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no panel divisions, no title, no watermark.
